summary: The manuscript reports zero SCN discoveries. Both published threshold conventions yield 22 on the deposited worksheet, and Gfap alone overlaps the three registered calls. The registered feature map reveals 38 discrepant expression profiles, including Septin1, and the historical SCN fit and feature assignments still require author clarification.

manualReview.summary: The deposited SCN worksheet gives 22 discoveries. The manuscript reports zero, and 38 author expression profiles differ from their registered features.
manualReview.note: The sample inventory, SCN expression columns, GEO records and registered sample sheet agree on 45 retained libraries (23 ALF, 22 TRF). The R 4.6.0 / edgeR 4.10.1 fit tested 16,999 features and published 16,997 gene effects. Of 18,846 author rows, 16,212 pair by unique author and registered output symbols. Pearson is 0.6883, Spearman is 0.7867 and 14,215 pairs agree in sign. All 22 worksheet discoveries agree in sign. Gfap alone passes both discovery rules. The other registered calls are Mylk3 and Cox7a1. The manuscript states zero SCN discoveries. Figure 2A/B omits SCN. Under ordinary BH, Gfap’s deposited adjusted and raw P values imply at least 19,268 tests at workbook precision. Registered TMM CPM recovers the corresponding GEO counts across all 24,533 displayed expression rows. The historical check found 37 discrepant profiles among 18,289 literal GEO/author symbol matches. Following the registered feature map adds 20 comparable rows and identifies one further discrepancy, Septin1. All 38 author profiles have an alternate GEO match at the historical tolerance. Of these, 35 have published registered DE statistics. Current identifier records link candidate labels for 29, including 13 cases where distinct NCBI GeneIDs share the workbook Ensembl ID. All paired rows retain their registered labels in the DE comparison.
reviewFlags: The Results section uses FDR <0.05 and STAR Methods uses FDR ≤0.05, both with logCPM >0. Both rules give 22 worksheet discoveries. The analysis underlying the manuscript’s zero remains unidentified.

The historical mapping from counts to annotated author rows remains unresolved. The registered Sep-01 row displays as Septin1. The author’s Septin1 expression matches GEO Gm4532, and both official symbols have distinct GeneIDs linked to the same Ensembl ID.

The registered model adjusts for ZT. The authors grouped samples across time and reported edgeR 3.26.7 and BH. The feature filtering, fitted model settings and complete BH family require clarification.

verificationReview.reason: The sample inventory and expression workbook support the registered 45-library cohort. The DE worksheet contains gene summaries, and the sample membership of the fit underlying the manuscript’s zero cannot be checked directly. Neither v2 effect route passes. Both published threshold conventions yield 22 worksheet discoveries. The historical feature assignments and complete author BH family remain unresolved.
verificationReview.nextStep: Ask which SCN fit, samples and selection rule produced the manuscript’s zero and how that result relates to the 22 Mendeley V1 calls. Request the pre-annotation count rows and versioned feature mapping, including Sep-01, Septin1 and Gm4532, the full BH family, and the design, filtering, offsets, dispersion and test settings or saved fits.

comparabilityReview.basis: Current registered R 4.6.0 / edgeR 4.10.1 SCN feeding coefficient adjusted additively for categorical ZT. Historical reruns are separate sensitivities.
comparabilityReview.reference: Mendeley V1 Dataset 2, complete exported SCN DE worksheet. Dataset 1 supplies the paired expression and sample inventory. The manuscript and Figure 2 were checked for the conflicting SCN result.

cohort.note: Dataset 1 marks three SCN outliers and contains expression for the remaining 23 ALF and 22 TRF libraries at 12 collection times. All 83 SCN GEO sample records map to those 45 registered libraries. Dataset 2 reports gene statistics without a fitted sample list.

contrast.note: Both effects compare nine-hour Western-diet TRF with Western-diet ALF in mouse SCN across the day. The manuscript describes pooling collection times as replicates. The registered effect adjusts for categorical ZT. Only ZT6 has unequal arm sizes (two ALF, one TRF).

features.note: The author workbooks share 18,846 unique Ensembl/symbol pairs. The DE join uses 16,212 exact author and registered output symbols. Among 18,309 expression pairs traced through the feature map, 38 exceed the historical tolerance, including 35 on the DE join. Of 20 joined output symbols normalized from GEO labels, Septin1 is the sole additional discrepancy. Its author profile matches GEO Gm4532 across 45 libraries. Distinct NCBI GeneIDs share the author Ensembl ID for 13 of the 38 cases. The historical feature assignments remain unresolved.

effects.note: Both coefficients are log2 TRF over ALF. Across all pairs Pearson is 0.6883 and Spearman is 0.7867. Signs agree in 14,215/16,212 nonzero pairs (87.68%). Median absolute log2FC difference is 0.0451. Both numerical routes fall below v2 thresholds.

inference.note: All 16,212 pairs have finite raw and adjusted P values. All 22 author calls and all three registered calls have statistics on both sides. Only Gfap passes both discovery rules. The Gfap adjusted/raw P ratio implies a BH family of at least 19,268 tests at workbook precision under standard unweighted BH. The manuscript reports zero SCN discoveries.

coverage.note: Paired effects cover 95.38% of the 16,997 registered rows, satisfying v2 full-table coverage. They cover 86.02% of the 18,846 author rows. There are 785 output-only and 2,634 author-only symbols. Two tested rows withheld from registered display remain in its BH family.

comparabilityReview.criteria: Use the full deposited worksheet, unique author and registered output symbols, and the labelled log2 TRF/ALF orientation. Under v2 the minimum is 30 pairs and 90% registered output coverage, with compatible cohort, contrast, identifiers and effect definitions. Both correlations must reach 0.90, or at least 90% of nonzero pairs must agree in direction with at least 30 nonzero pairs covering 90% of all pairs. For author calls, Results uses FDR <0.05 and STAR Methods uses FDR ≤0.05, both with logCPM >0. The dataset comparison uses local FDR ≤0.05 on the registered filtered universe. Neither table has a boundary tie. Significance and effect magnitude are contextual.
comparabilityReview.conclusion: Cohort, orientation and full-table output coverage are supported. Neither v2 effect route passes. The manuscript/worksheet conflict, historical feature identities and incomplete author testing family require clarification.

computed.value: 45 retained from 48, with 23 ALF and 22 TRF across 12 ZTs. The 83 SCN GSM records resolve to the same 45 libraries.
16,999 tested rows, 16,997 published. 16,212 paired to 18,846 author rows. Output-only 785, author-only 2,634. Output coverage 95.3815%, reference coverage 86.0236%.

computed.claim: Effect comparison on all finite pairs
computed.value: Pearson 0.68833434, Spearman 0.78668128, 14,215/16,212 nonzero effects concordant (87.68196%). Median absolute log2FC difference 0.04509517. Neither v2 route passes.

22 author and 3 registered discoveries, with 1 overlap (Gfap) and Jaccard 1/24. All 22 agree in sign. Paired raw P and FDR available for all 16,212, with zero positive calls missing the other side's statistic. No FDR equals 0.05.

Gfap raw P 1.22814364811245e-23 and FDR 2.36638718118307e-19 give FDR/P ≈19,268. BH on the 18,846 exported raw P values gives 2.3145595192327233e-19 for this gene. The reported BH value implies a larger testing family.
24,537 rows, 24,535 symbols after duplicate-label sums. The 24,533 visible registered TMM CPM rows invert to the corresponding GEO counts with maximum absolute count residual 6.76e-9 or less.

computed.claim: Historical source scaling check and differently labelled profiles
computed.value: Of 18,289 literal GEO/author symbol matches, 18,252 agree at the prespecified tolerance and 37 differ. Every discrepant author profile has an alternate GEO match across 45 libraries. None is an author discovery. Of the 37, 34 have a published registered DE row and none of those 34 is a registered discovery.

computed.claim: Independent identifier support for candidate GEO labels
computed.value: 36 of 37 have one numerical candidate and Gpr146 has two. For 28 of 37, a candidate name has a current authority link. For 12, separate NCBI GeneIDs with the two official symbols share the workbook Ensembl ID. Nine have no candidate linked under the stated lookup rule.

computed.claim: Contents of the paper's supplemental DE and figure-source workbooks
computed.value: mmc3.xlsx lists 17 tissues and omits SCN. The mmc4.xlsx up/down lists have 816/1,335 genes recurring in at least 5 tissues and zero SCN tissue entries. Data S1 contains sheets for Figures 5B, 6C and S1.

computed.claim: Expression correspondence using the registered feature map
computed.value: The map adds 20 author/output symbol pairs whose original GEO labels differ. Nineteen pass the historical profile check. Septin1 (GEO Sep-01) exceeds tolerance in 35/45 samples, with maximum scaled residual 2.20801008. The author profile matches GEO Gm4532 in all 45. Septin1 log2FC is +0.23173171 in the worksheet and −1.11345475 in the registered result. Its FDRs are 1 and 0.88998757. In total 38/18,309 expression pairs differ, including 35/16,212 DE pairs. Defb42, Klra4 and Mef2b have no published registered DE row. The full DE comparison includes every paired effect.

computed.claim: Identifier evidence for the additional Septin1 discrepancy
computed.value: Septin1 (NCBI GeneID 54204) and Gm4532 (100043580) are separate official records that both cite the workbook ID ENSMUSG00000000486. Across all 38 discrepancies, 29 have a candidate linked under the stated authority rule, 13 involve distinct GeneIDs that share the corresponding author row’s Ensembl ID, and nine lack a linked candidate.

openIssues: Which SCN samples, fit and selection step gave zero in the manuscript when both published FDR conventions give 22 in Mendeley V1?

Which input feature IDs, mapping and duplicate-resolution steps produced the GEO and author labels, including Sep-01, Septin1 and Gm4532? Which tested rows and edgeR settings yielded the deposited F and BH FDR values?
